Nothing leaves your device unless you ask the cloud AI
Your questions are interpreted and answered on the device itself. The internet is used to download signed data package updates from saibatudo.net and, only when you ask, to consult the cloud AI.
What is stored on the device

Your preferences: theme, text size, level, data saver and automatic cloud AI; and the random identifier of this installation, used only in requests to the cloud AI. If “Help improve the app” is on, also the queue of questions not yet sent.
The history of your last questions (up to 30), only so you can reuse them. You can delete it below.
The data package and the updates downloaded.

When looking for an update, the app makes HTTPS requests to saibatudo.net to download the data files. As with any internet access, the server sees the IP address and the app version. No usage data is sent. The text of a question only leaves the device when you tap “Ask the cloud AI” or turn on automatic cloud AI. With “Help improve the app” (optional, below), the questions not understood that you choose to send also leave.
What the app does not have
No login, no ads, no usage analytics, no location, no access to contacts, camera or microphone.

Optional and off by default. When you tap “Ask the cloud AI” (or turn on the automatic option in Settings), the app sends saibatudo.net only the text of that question (up to 300 characters) and a random identifier of this installation, which does not identify you and is used only for the usage limit. In a follow-up question (“and for potassium?”), the interpretation of the previous question (intent and entities, such as “molar mass” and “NaCl”) is sent too, never its text or the history. The model only interprets the question: every name, symbol and unit is checked against the data on the device, and the numbers always come from the signed package. The server does not log the question; it is kept only in a temporary in-memory cache.
